# CORE-RSK-02

**Are the regulatory, contractual and policy obligations named, with how the design classes under each?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [Core architecture lens](core.md) 0.6.0 |
| Area | RSK: Risk and obligations |
| Default severity | major |
| Decided by | A reviewer |
| Reads | `drivers.obligations` |

## Why it matters

Naming obligations is architecture; certifying against them is a separate assessment the design hands over to.

## Sources

- Regulation (EU) 2024/1689, Annex IV, technical documentation (`eu-aiact-annex4`)
